stories.title: Bootstrap: audit, ADR, parity, backlog, docs and baseline gates
stories.description: Clone and audit the repo, verify external constraints, document keep/replace decisions, create the parity matrix and backlog, and record honest baseline gate results.
acceptance: Audit records stack, features, assumptions, gate output, vulnerabilities and secret-scan limits
ADR-001 includes scored options and verified sources with dates
PARITY covers every audited feature with story references
prd.json covers E0-E13 with dependencies
Docs set and AGENTS.md exist; no secrets committed

stories.title: pnpm + Turborepo monorepo with shared packages
stories.description: Move the Next.js app to apps/web and add the foundation workspace packages: packages/domain (shared product/domain code) and packages/config (shared TypeScript base). Defer api-client, sync-protocol, ui-tokens and i18n until their owning stories have real code; do not create empty shells.
acceptance: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and pnpm typecheck pass; web builds from apps/web
Workspace packages have no app-specific imports; @letsvibe/domain is consumed by apps/web
CI paths, Vercel root directory and docs updated
No behavioural change; existing tests pass
stories.notes: Delivered apps/web, @letsvibe/domain and @letsvibe/config in one mechanical change. Deferred empty api-client/sync-protocol/ui-tokens/i18n packages to the stories that first consume them. Gates: frozen-lockfile install, typegen, typecheck (domain + web), lint, vitest 5 files/44 tests, Next build 33 pages. Local Windows needs a user-writable corepack shim on PATH for Turborepo.

stories.title: CI secret scanning, dependency audit and SAST
stories.description: Add gitleaks full-history scanning and dependency/SAST checks to CI with documented suppression policy.
acceptance: gitleaks runs on push and PR over full history and fails on findings
Production dependency audit runs with a documented threshold and allowlist
Semgrep or CodeQL baseline runs and uploads results
No secrets found in the current history or a rotation plan exists

stories.title: Patch critical/high dependency advisories
stories.description: Upgrade Next.js and its ESLint config to the patched 16.4.6 release, resolve the transitive zod advisory with a pnpm 12 workspace override, and verify that production dependencies are audit-clean without breaking build or tests.
acceptance: Critical Next advisories resolved (Next 16.4.6) with tests/build green
pnpm audit --prod reports zero critical/high findings; remaining dev-only findings are documented with reachability
Transitive zod advisory fixed with a documented override
No major-framework migration beyond the intended patch
stories.notes: Upgraded next and eslint-config-next 16.3.6 -> 16.4.6, zod -> 4.6.7, and added a pnpm-workspace.yaml override for the exact 4.1.11 pin under @vercel/cli-config. pnpm audit --prod: no known vulnerabilities; full audit: 2 moderate dev-only (esbuild via drizzle-kit legacy chain, minimatch via ESLint). Gates: frozen-lockfile install, typegen, typecheck, lint, 44 tests, build 33 pages.

stories.title: Observability baseline: errors, logs, health, alerts
stories.description: Add Sentry (web and mobile), structured server logs with request ids, a health endpoint and basic alert routing; exclude message/media content from telemetry.
acceptance: Unhandled server/client errors reach Sentry with release and route, no PII/content
Requests carry ids and emit structured logs
/api/health checks DB and storage read with safe output
Alerts for error-rate and uptime go to a monitored channel

stories.title: Separate staging and production environments
stories.description: Create isolated Supabase staging/production projects and Vercel environments, with no loop access to production and documented secret ownership.
acceptance: Staging deploys automatically; production requires human action
Secrets are scoped per environment and never committed
.env.example matches required variables
Loop credentials cannot reach production data

stories.title: One-command developer experience and docs
stories.description: Make pnpm install/dev/test/build work from a fresh clone with local Supabase or PGlite, generic seed, and fix the Turbopack root warning.
acceptance: Fresh clone: documented setup succeeds on Windows and macOS/Linux
Seed creates a generic demo couple, not Hassan/Whitney
typegen requirement is documented; turbopack.root set
README and AGENTS.md commands match reality
stories.notes: Generic Alex/Sam seed; pnpm run setup verified in a fresh workspace on Windows; gates passed; macOS/Linux commands documented but not executed. See progress iteration 005.

stories.title: CI gates and PR template
stories.description: Extend CI to typegen, typecheck, lint, unit tests, web build and (once ready) RLS tests and mobile typecheck; add a PR template with evidence and rollback.
acceptance: Every gate is required on PRs; failures block merge
CI caching keeps median run under 10 minutes
PR template requires story id, gate evidence, parity and risk notes
No gate is silently skipped

stories.title: Identity schema: couples, members, invitations, profiles, consents
stories.description: Add the multi-tenant identity model and backfill the existing relationship into a couple while keeping existing queries compiling through an adapter.
acceptance: couples, couple_members, invitations, profiles, consents tables exist with indexes
Existing relationship/people are migrated into a couple with both members
A person cannot be in more than one active couple in v1
Schema tests cover constraints (max 2 active members, invite single-use)

stories.title: RLS foundation helpers and core policies
stories.description: Create is_couple_member() and default-deny policies for identity and relationship tables, with storage/realtime authorization patterns documented.
acceptance: RLS is enabled on identity tables and anonymous access is denied
Couple members can read/write only their couple rows
Helpers are SECURITY DEFINER with pinned search_path and reviewed
pgTAP tests prove member and non-member behaviour

stories.title: Supabase Auth: email OTP sign-in, sessions, claim flow
stories.description: Replace slug/passcode login with Supabase Auth for the web app, including server session verification, middleware and a one-time claim for the two existing accounts.
acceptance: Sign-in email OTP works end to end; session is httpOnly/refresh-safe
Existing couple can claim accounts without losing data
Passcode login removed only after claim is verified on staging
Auth flows have tests and middleware coverage; no redirect loops

stories.title: Apple and Google sign-in (web + native)
stories.description: Add Apple and Google identity providers with nonce/state validation, account linking rules and store-compliant disclosure.
acceptance: Apple and Google sign-in succeed on web and Expo
Identities link to one person; duplicate-account rule is enforced
4.8-compliant disclosure and Sign in with Apple are present on iOS
Tokens never reach logs or client-readable storage beyond the SDK

stories.title: Partner invitations
stories.description: Let a signed-in member invite exactly one partner via single-use link/code with expiry, revoke and acceptance rules.
acceptance: Invite is single-use, expires after 24 hours by default (configurable), revocable, and capped at 2 active members
Accepting binds the invitee to the couple only after explicit consent
Expired/invalid/used invites show clear errors
Invite creation and acceptance are rate limited and audited
stories.notes: Core slice implemented: signed 24-hour partner links, server-side acceptance, one-time fill and clear used/expired states. Remaining: rate limiting, audit log, revoke and E1-003 multi-tenant auth.

stories.title: Onboarding wizard
stories.description: Collect names, world names, relationship start date, time zone, topics and notification preferences, resumable on web and native.
acceptance: New members complete onboarding before seeing shared content
Progress persists and can resume; validation and defaults are clear
Values drive home, daily question, room and digest behaviour
Skipping optional fields yields a sensible default
stories.notes: First-run /welcome and /join/[token] implemented with required interest selection and colour choice; trends use saved interests. Remaining: timezone/notification defaults, resumable progress and native parity.

stories.title: Account settings and session management
stories.description: Manage display name, email change with verification, active sessions and sign-out-everywhere.
acceptance: Email change verifies both old and new address
Users can list and revoke sessions
Sign out everywhere invalidates refresh tokens
Sensitive changes are notified to the account email

stories.title: Export my data
stories.description: Async export of profile, shared content and a media manifest with secure expiring download links.
acceptance: Export request queues a job and emails a short-lived link
Archive contains JSON for relational data and files/links for media
Only data the requester can access is included (RLS enforced)
Large exports are chunked and rate limited

stories.title: Delete account and couple data
stories.description: In-app deletion with 30-day grace, partner notification, complete purge job and audit trail, available on web and native.
acceptance: Deletion is reachable in-app on web and iOS
Grace period allows cancel; purge removes DB rows and Storage objects
Partner is notified and retains their own export rights
Audit records the request and purge without content

stories.title: Unlink / leave a couple
stories.description: Define and implement leave semantics for shared vs personal content, with confirmation and no orphaned private data.
acceptance: Either partner can leave at any time without the other's consent
Access to the shared space ends immediately for the leaver on unlink
Both can export their own contributions during a 30-day grace window; data is then deleted unless both opt to keep
Account can later join a new couple, and RLS/tests cover post-leave access

stories.title: Recovery and lockout support
stories.description: Cover lost email access, OTP failure and account lockout with admin-assisted, audited recovery.
acceptance: Documented recovery flow with verification steps
Admin recovery requires break-glass reason and writes audit log
User is notified of any recovery action
No social-engineering shortcut bypasses email verification

stories.title: Entitlements and limits model
stories.description: Add a free-tier entitlement model for storage, AI usage, rooms and exports that can later support premium plans.
acceptance: Entitlements are server-side, per couple, and cannot be edited by clients
Limits are enforced at upload/AI/room creation points
UI shows usage and clear limit errors
Admin overrides are audited

stories.title: Remove single-couple hardcoding
stories.description: Replace Hassan/Whitney names, world vocabulary, themes and metadata with per-couple settings and neutral fallbacks.
acceptance: No shipped UI or metadata names the founding couple
World names/colours come from settings with accessible defaults
Public profile uses the couple's chosen display names only
Search for Hassan/Whitney finds only seed/demo fixtures, not app copy
stories.notes: Current shipped tree has no founding-couple names; neutral us/indigo/sage themes and per-person colour selection; relationship name editable; public profiles use chosen names only. E2E and name search clean.

stories.title: Per-couple time zone for daily questions and digests
stories.description: Compute local days from the couple's time zone instead of hardcoded Nairobi and cover DST/travel cases.
acceptance: Daily question and digest use the couple's time zone
Both partners see the same question and reveal rules
DST transitions and time-zone changes are handled
Existing answers migrate without duplicates

stories.title: Roll out couple_id to all couple-owned tables
stories.description: Add couple_id, indexes and backfill for every couple-scoped table while relationship_id remains temporarily.
acceptance: Every couple-owned table has a NOT NULL couple_id with an index
Backfill is correct and repeatable with a verification query
Foreign keys prevent cross-couple references where feasible
Schema documentation lists ownership for all 30+ tables

stories.title: RLS for all tables, storage and realtime
stories.description: Enable default-deny RLS on every table, Storage bucket policy and realtime channel authorization.
acceptance: All tables have RLS enabled and explicit member policies
Storage buckets enforce couple paths server-side
Realtime private channels authorize via RLS
Service-role keys exist only in server envs and are never shipped

stories.title: Cross-couple regression test suite in CI
stories.description: Build pgTAP/storage tests that fail on any cross-couple read or write for every table and bucket, and gate merges on them.
acceptance: A generated matrix covers every couple-owned table
Tests create two couples and prove isolation on select/insert/update/delete
Storage path traversal and signed URL cross-use are tested
CI fails if a new table lacks coverage

stories.title: Remove single-couple context resolution
stories.description: Replace ctxFor limit(1) and partners[0] with an explicit session-derived couple context used by all routes and actions.
acceptance: No remaining limit(1) relationship lookup or hardcoded partner index
All server handlers resolve couple membership from the verified session
A request for another couple returns 404/403, never data
Context helpers have unit tests

stories.title: Visibility and public-profile review
stories.description: Audit visibleTo semantics, opt-in public profiles and slug uniqueness; prove personal data stays private.
acceptance: Public profile requires explicit opt-in and shows only allowed fields
Slugs are unique per couple context, not global identity
Personal/shared/public rules are tested
No API can bypass visibility filters

stories.title: Admin audit log and break-glass access
stories.description: Add an immutable audit log and admin access requiring a reason for any couple-data view or action.
acceptance: Admin actions record actor, reason, target and timestamp
Audit log is append-only and searchable by admins
Break-glass access expires and alerts
No admin UI exposes message/media content by default

stories.title: Retire legacy base64 photos table
stories.description: Move legacy photos into Storage and remove the base64-in-Postgres path.
acceptance: All legacy photos are migrated with checksums
Gallery reads only the new schema
Legacy table access is removed and later dropped
Storage policy tests cover migrated objects

stories.title: Retention and cleanup jobs
stories.description: Schedule TTL cleanup for call signals, soft-deleted content, idle sessions and stale invites.
acceptance: Call signals and stale invites expire automatically
Soft-delete purge respects grace periods and exports
Jobs are idempotent, monitored and report counts
Retention windows are documented in the privacy policy

stories.title: Realtime client and private channel convention
stories.description: Add a shared realtime provider using Supabase private channels with reconnect, auth refresh and polling fallback.
acceptance: Channels are named per couple and authorized by RLS
Reconnect and token refresh are handled without duplicate subscriptions
A feature flag can fall back to polling
Web and native share the channel protocol types

stories.title: Chat realtime delivery with durable writes
stories.description: Send, edit and delete via server actions while delivering updates over realtime, keeping client_id idempotency.
acceptance: Messages persist before broadcast; retries are idempotent
Recipients see new messages under 300 ms locally, without poll writes
Edit/delete permissions and time limits preserved
Polling fallback still works

stories.title: Read, delivered, typing and presence via broadcast
stories.description: Move per-tick writes off the polling path; throttle typing and presence broadcasts.
acceptance: No DB write occurs merely because a client polled
Read/delivered receipts update reliably after reconnect
Typing indicators throttle and expire
Presence privacy setting is respected

stories.title: Replies, reactions and message actions parity
stories.description: Realtime updates for replies and reactions with full parity and tests.
acceptance: Replies/reactions sync in realtime for both partners
Optimistic updates reconcile without duplicates
Delete-for-everyone removes content for both; delete-for-me is local
Existing tests pass and new realtime tests cover each action

stories.title: Message push notifications
stories.description: Deliver push for new messages on web and Expo with quiet hours, preview privacy and dedupe.
acceptance: Push arrives when app is backgrounded with a content-free option
Per-partner quiet hours and per-type preferences apply
Duplicate pushes are suppressed; badges stay consistent
Push payloads carry no sensitive content by default

stories.title: Unread counts and app badge consistency
stories.description: Centralize unread counts and badge state across web, native and push.
acceptance: Unread counts reconcile after reconnect and read receipts
Badge clears on open without losing new arrivals
Web and native show the same count
Counts are per couple and per device

stories.title: Chat image and voice-note uploads
stories.description: Attach images and voice notes stored in the couple bucket with progress and retry.
acceptance: Uploads use couple-scoped paths and signed URLs
Progress, cancel and retry work; failures are visible
Voice notes play inline with duration metadata
Only the couple can access attachments

stories.title: Chat load test at target concurrency
stories.description: Prove chat at 1,500 concurrent users across 10,000 couples with realtime and DB within budget.
acceptance: p95 message delivery under 1 s (target 500 ms); errors under 0.1%
Realtime connection counts stay within the selected plan
DB writes per message are bounded and documented
Results and plan sizing recorded in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md

stories.title: Conversation pagination and jump-to-message
stories.description: Paginate long chats with stable cursors and deep links to a message.
acceptance: Cursor pagination has no duplicates/gaps under concurrent inserts
Deep links open the right page and highlight the message
Memory stays bounded on long histories
Works offline with cached pages

stories.title: Realtime call signalling
stories.description: Replace polling signalling with realtime events and a reviewed call state machine and cleanup.
acceptance: Offer/answer/ICE/candidates flow over private channel
State machine covers ring/accept/decline/miss/timeout/hangup/reconnect
Stale calls and signals are cleaned up
No signal polling remains

stories.title: Native ringing and call entry
stories.description: Wake the callee with push and route into the call via CallKit (iOS) and ConnectionService/full-screen intent (Android), plus web notification.
acceptance: Backgrounded devices receive a ringing UI and can accept/decline
Permissions and audio routing are correct
Deep link opens the call after auth
Store policy for VoIP push and CallKit is followed

stories.title: TURN provisioning and abuse limits
stories.description: Issue short-lived per-call TURN credentials with rate limits; no global relay secret in the client.
acceptance: Credentials are per call/couple, short TTL and revocable
Relay usage is rate limited and monitored
Failures fall back to a clear message, not silent failure
No TURN secret is shipped to clients or logs

stories.title: Call history and missed-call badges
stories.description: Surface call history and missed calls consistently in chat, home and app icons.
acceptance: History lists duration, direction and outcome
Missed calls increment badges and clear when viewed
History is couple-private and exportable
Old signal rows do not leak into history

stories.title: Call resilience and quality signals
stories.description: Handle ICE restarts, reconnects and degradation; capture anonymous quality metrics.
acceptance: Transient network loss recovers without dropping the call
Poor conditions prompt audio-only or retry
Quality metrics are aggregated without content
Reconnect UX is tested on throttled networks

stories.title: Presence without per-tick writes
stories.description: Use realtime presence for online/last-seen and remove presence writes from polling.
acceptance: Online state updates within 2 s without DB writes
Last-seen is stored at most on disconnect and stays private
Privacy toggle disables presence/last-seen
Pulse endpoint no longer upserts presence

stories.title: External-service screen-share policy and countdown mode
stories.description: Stop implying screen-share works for DRM services; implement shared countdown mode and clear copy.
acceptance: Countdown sync is available for films/services without APIs
UI explains DRM/black-screen limits honestly
Store copy and screenshots make no unsupported claims
Feature flag can disable screen share entirely

stories.title: Call privacy and recording policy
stories.description: Ensure calls are not recorded by default and any future recording requires explicit two-party consent.
acceptance: No recording path exists in v1
UI and policy state calls are not recorded
If recording is ever added, both parties consent with visible notice
Server logs never contain call content

stories.title: Media source provider interface
stories.description: Define a provider interface with YouTube, uploaded media, podcast audio and countdown implementations, including validation and attribution metadata.
acceptance: Providers expose playable metadata, validation and licence/attribution fields
YouTube uses oEmbed/IFrame metadata without scraping or downloading
Unsupported URLs fail with a clear reason
Provider selection is server-validated

stories.title: Realtime room playback sync
stories.description: Move room state to realtime with play/pause/seek/queue, drift correction and late-joiner snapshots.
acceptance: p95 sync drift stays under 500 ms (audio target 400 ms)
Late joiners receive a correct snapshot
Either partner can control playback; heartbeats are ≤1 per 5 s per client
Polling fallback remains for old clients

stories.title: Room chat, reactions, nudges and queue parity
stories.description: Realtime room chat/reactions/nudges and a shared queue with voting.
acceptance: All room interactions sync in realtime
Queue edits are ordered and conflict-free
Reactions/nudges rate limit and expire
Chat in rooms is retained per room policy

stories.title: Persistent mini-player
stories.description: Keep room audio/video playing across navigation and refresh with correct resume state.
acceptance: Player survives route changes and reloads
State resumes at the synced position
Only one player instance exists; no echo
Mobile behavior follows platform background-audio rules

stories.title: Room uploads and couple-only sharing
stories.description: Play uploaded songs/videos from couple Storage with explicit consent and signed playback URLs.
acceptance: Uploads go to couple paths and are playable by both partners
Consent explains storage limits and partner visibility
Playback uses short-lived signed URLs
Deleting media stops room playback gracefully

stories.title: Licensed music catalogue behind verified licence
stories.description: Add a CC/catalogue provider only after checking terms and licence metadata; keep it feature-flagged off until legal confirms.
acceptance: Licence terms for the provider are documented and approved
Per-track licence/attribution is stored and displayed
Non-commercial-only sources are blocked for a commercial service
Feature flag disables the provider without breaking rooms

stories.title: Countdown and external-service sync
stories.description: Implement shared countdown-to-play for services and content that cannot be embedded.
acceptance: Both partners can start a countdown and see the same target time
Clock skew is handled using server time
Instructions are clear and do not promise in-app playback
No DRM bypass or black-screen capture claims

stories.title: Room load test at 300 rooms
stories.description: Prove 300 concurrent rooms and 1,500 users with bounded realtime and DB load.
acceptance: p95 sync latency within target; no channel leaks
Realtime message rate stays within plan limits
Room creation has per-couple rate limits
Results documented with plan sizing

stories.title: YouTube compliance implementation
stories.description: Ensure the official player, attribution, no download/offline use and store review notes comply with YouTube API Services policies.
acceptance: Official IFrame player only; no proxying or downloading media
YouTube attribution/links and privacy disclosure present
No background audio for YouTube content
Store review notes describe compliance

stories.title: Couple-scoped Storage buckets and policies
stories.description: Create private buckets with couple paths and server-enforced access, replacing Blob as the primary store.
acceptance: Buckets are private; paths start with the authenticated couple id
Storage policies deny cross-couple access and traversal
Signed URL expiry is short and configurable
Service-role use is server-only

stories.title: Resumable uploads with validation
stories.description: Web and native uploads with TUS/resumable behavior, progress, retry, MIME sniffing and size limits.
acceptance: Interrupted uploads resume without duplicates
Server validates MIME/extension mismatch and enforces limits
Progress/cancel/retry are visible and accessible
Uploads are idempotent per client id

stories.title: Per-couple storage quotas
stories.description: Enforce storage count/bytes quotas server-side with usage UI and entitlement hooks.
acceptance: Quota checks occur before upload and atomically reserve bytes
UI shows usage and clear upgrade/delete guidance
Deleting media releases quota
Admin overrides are audited

stories.title: Upload moderation and quarantine
stories.description: Scan uploads with a CSAM hash-matching provider and text filters; quarantine and report before partner visibility.
acceptance: Visual media is scanned before it becomes visible to the partner
Matches are quarantined, reported per law, and never shown
Failures fail closed with a clear user message
Provider contract and legal process are documented

stories.title: Gallery comments, reactions and new badge realtime
stories.description: Move gallery reactions/comments to realtime with pagination and unread state.
acceptance: Comments/reactions update live for both partners
Pagination is stable for long threads
New badge clears per viewer
Deletes remove content for both

stories.title: Image processing, EXIF and caching
stories.description: Strip EXIF, generate thumbnails/transforms, cache signed URLs safely and invalidate on delete.
acceptance: GPS/EXIF is removed from uploads by default
Thumbnails render quickly without loading originals
Signed URL caching does not outlive expiry
Deletes invalidate CDN/cache

stories.title: Migrate existing Blob media
stories.description: Copy and verify existing Vercel Blob and legacy photos into couple Storage with checksums and rollback.
acceptance: Every object is copied, checksummed and readable
Old paths are mapped without breaking gallery links
Rollback is possible until sign-off
Migration report lists misses

stories.title: Media deletion and purge
stories.description: Delete media from DB, Storage and caches with a reliable purge queue.
acceptance: User delete removes access immediately and purges bytes within the grace window
Failed purges retry and alert
Account deletion purges all objects
Partner sees deletion per product policy

stories.title: Per-couple topics and source settings
stories.description: Make the 8 topics and 39 sources editable defaults rather than global constants.
acceptance: Couples choose topics/sources during onboarding and settings
Default feed works with no choices
Disabled sources stop appearing for that couple
Settings persist across web/native

stories.title: Multi-tenant ingestion pipeline
stories.description: Keep a global source registry with per-couple subscriptions, filters and idempotent scheduled ingestion.
acceptance: Ingest is idempotent and retries with backoff
Per-couple filters apply without duplicating content storage
Source health is visible per couple
Cron failures alert

stories.title: AI usage metering and quotas
stories.description: Meter Gemini usage per user/couple, enforce quotas, allow optional BYO key encrypted server-side, and control cost.
acceptance: Every AI call records tokens/cost against an entitlement
Over-quota requests fail gracefully with reset guidance
BYO keys are encrypted at rest and never returned to clients
Admin usage overrides are audited

stories.title: AI safety and citation quality
stories.description: Add prompt-injection defences, output moderation, citation checks, crisis routing and privacy-safe logging.
acceptance: Untrusted feed/web content cannot hijack system instructions
Unsafe outputs are blocked or rewritten with a safe fallback
Citations link to real retrieved sources
Crisis keywords route to external help; logs omit content

stories.title: Image licensing and attribution pipeline
stories.description: Allowlist image sources, store licence/attribution, and stop unlicensed hotlinking at scale.
acceptance: Each image has source, licence and attribution metadata
Only allowlisted providers are used; fallbacks exist
Attribution renders where required
Broken/blocked images degrade gracefully

stories.title: Saved discoveries and weekly digest per couple
stories.description: Couple-scoped saving and a weekly digest aligned to the couple's time zone.
acceptance: Saved items are couple-scoped and private
Digest sends per couple time zone and preferences
Unsubscribe and quiet hours work
Digest links deep-link correctly on web/native

stories.title: Tenant-scoped search
stories.description: Ensure global search queries only the caller's couple and never leaks counts or snippets.
acceptance: Search results are filtered by RLS and explicit couple scope
Cross-couple queries return empty, not partial data
Search covers messages, memories, media metadata and discoveries
Performance tests cover 10k couples

stories.title: Expo app skeleton with auth and shared packages
stories.description: Create the Expo Router app with secure session storage, deep links, EAS project and shared type packages; CI typechecks it.
acceptance: App builds for iOS and Android via EAS
Auth deep links and secure storage work
Shared packages resolve without duplication
CI typechecks the app and runs on PRs

stories.title: Home, journey and daily question parity
stories.description: Bring the core home experience and daily question to native.
acceptance: Journey clock, verse and daily question match web
Answer hiding and reveal rules are identical
Offline shows cached last state with a clear label
Pull-to-refresh and time-zone handling work

stories.title: Native chat with push and offline queue
stories.description: Chat parity with realtime, push, media and an offline outbox that survives restarts.
acceptance: Messages send/retry offline and reconcile on reconnect
Push opens the right conversation
Read receipts and typing work in background/foreground transitions
No duplicate messages after retries

stories.title: Native WebRTC calls
stories.description: Voice/video calls with react-native-webrtc, CallKit/ConnectionService, permissions, audio routing and reconnect.
acceptance: Calls connect between iOS, Android and web
Audio routing (speaker/earpiece/Bluetooth) works
Background/locked-screen ringing works
Reconnect and hangup are reliable

stories.title: Native gallery and camera uploads
stories.description: Gallery browsing plus camera/photo-picker uploads with resumable progress.
acceptance: Photo/video capture and upload work with permissions handled
Progress and retry match web behavior
Large files resume after backgrounding
Deleted media disappears everywhere

stories.title: Native room player and background audio
stories.description: Audio/video room playback with queue and platform background-audio rules.
acceptance: Audio continues per platform policy with a visible control
Sync with partner stays within target
YouTube content remains foreground-only
Mini-player survives navigation

stories.title: Native onboarding, settings and deletion
stories.description: Full onboarding, settings, export and account deletion on native.
acceptance: Onboarding and settings match web fields
Export request and deletion are available in-app
Session management signs out devices
Apple 5.1.1(v) evidence captured

stories.title: Native accessibility and dynamic type
stories.description: VoiceOver/TalkBack labels, focus order, dynamic type and reduced motion across core screens.
acceptance: Core flows pass screen-reader walkthroughs
Dynamic type does not clip critical UI
Reduced motion is respected
Accessibility checklist is in the repo

stories.title: EAS build profiles, versioning and OTA policy
stories.description: Define dev/preview/production profiles, versioning, update channels and rollback.
acceptance: Build profiles are documented and reproducible
Version/build numbers increment automatically
OTA updates are limited to JS-safe changes with rollback
Store binaries map to source commits

stories.title: Verify API 36 and 16 KB page support
stories.description: Confirm the chosen Expo/RN/SDK versions meet Google Play API 36 and 16 KB page requirements before store builds.
acceptance: Target SDK 36 is set and verified in the build
Native libraries are 16 KB aligned; Play pre-launch report passes
Expo/RN versions documented with sources
Upgrade path recorded if not supported

stories.title: Report and block across content types
stories.description: Report messages, profiles, media and rooms; block a partner or user with clear effects and evidence capture.
acceptance: Report flow captures reason and context without exposing reporter by default
Blocking stops content and notifications per policy
Reports are stored securely and reach the admin queue
Abuse flows are tested end to end

stories.title: Moderation queue and admin actions
stories.description: Build a minimal admin console with SLAs, warn/remove/suspend, NCII escalation and audit.
acceptance: Queue shows reports with age and priority
Actions are audited and reversible where appropriate
NCII and imminent-harm escalation steps are documented and tested
Response-time SLA is tracked

stories.title: Public safety, contact and help pages
stories.description: Publish contact info, safety guidelines and reporting help required by Apple 1.2.
acceptance: Contact email and response expectation are public
Safety guidelines cover UGC and reporting
Help is linked from settings and store listings
Pages are accessible and localized minimally

stories.title: Age gate, terms and consent log
stories.description: 18+ attestation, ToS/privacy acceptance, consent records and re-consent on policy changes.
acceptance: New users attest 18+ and accept terms before use
Consent version and timestamp are stored
Policy changes require re-consent
Declining blocks use with a clear path

stories.title: Abuse and rate limiting
stories.description: Per-IP/user/couple limits for auth, invites, uploads, AI and calls with bot protections.
acceptance: Limits are server-side and shared across instances
Invite and OTP abuse is throttled
Limits return clear, non-enumerating errors
Anomalies alert

stories.title: Secret and key inventory with rotation
stories.description: Inventory all secrets, rotation owners and schedules; least-privilege service keys.
acceptance: Every secret has an owner, scope and rotation date
Rotating session/TURN/AI keys is rehearsed
No long-lived secret is shared across environments
Access reviews are scheduled

stories.title: Incident response and breach runbook
stories.description: Write and rehearse an incident runbook with roles, communication and notification timelines.
acceptance: Severity levels and roles are defined
Breach notification steps and legal contacts are documented
A tabletop exercise is completed and dated
Customer communication templates exist

stories.title: WCAG 2.2 AA web audit and fixes
stories.description: Audit and fix critical web flows for WCAG 2.2 AA, with automated axe checks.
acceptance: Home, chat, call, gallery, settings pass axe with no critical issues
Keyboard and focus order work for core flows
Contrast and target sizes meet AA
Known exceptions are documented with dates

stories.title: Native accessibility audit
stories.description: Run VoiceOver/TalkBack audits and fix core native flows.
acceptance: Sign-in, home, chat, call and gallery pass a11y checklists
All actionable elements have labels and hints
Focus order and modals behave correctly
Report is stored in docs

stories.title: i18n scaffold and locale formatting
stories.description: Externalize strings and format dates/numbers per locale; English launch but no hardcoded assumptions.
acceptance: No user-facing string is hardcoded in components
Date/time/plural formatting uses a locale library
Pseudo-locale build catches truncation
RTL readiness is assessed

stories.title: Shared design tokens and per-couple theming
stories.description: Extract colours/spacing/type into tokens used by web and native; themes come from couple settings.
acceptance: Tokens are the single source for both platforms
Two couple themes render correctly and accessibly
Dark/light contrast passes AA
No hardcoded brand names in the theme layer

stories.title: Reduced motion and contrast verification
stories.description: Verify motion, animation and contrast settings across web and native.
acceptance: prefers-reduced-motion disables non-essential motion
High-contrast mode remains usable
No flashing content violates guidelines
Checks are added to the a11y checklist

stories.title: Load-test harness and target-scale profile
stories.description: Build reusable load tests for 10,000 couples / 1,500 concurrent users and record baselines.
acceptance: Harness can simulate chat, presence, rooms and calls at target scale
Baseline results are recorded with hardware/plan details
Bottlenecks have owners and stories
Harness runs in staging without affecting production

stories.title: Indexes, query budgets and pooling
stories.description: Review slow queries, add indexes and document pool/realtime limits at scale.
acceptance: No query on hot paths exceeds budget at 10k couples
Indexes are justified by EXPLAIN evidence
Connection pooling is sized and documented
Realtime fan-out limits are mapped to the chosen plan

stories.title: Backup and restore drill
stories.description: Prove PITR and object-storage restore with documented RPO/RTO.
acceptance: A staging restore to a point in time succeeds and is timed
Storage objects restore/verify with checksums
RPO/RTO are documented and acceptable
Drill is scheduled quarterly

stories.title: SLOs, alerts and status page
stories.description: Define SLOs for availability, chat delivery and call setup; add alerts and a status page/process.
acceptance: SLOs have targets and measurement
Alerts page a monitored channel with runbooks
Status communication process exists
Dashboards show error rate, latency and saturation

stories.title: Cost model at 10,000 couples
stories.description: Model monthly cost for Supabase, Vercel, TURN, AI, push, storage and EAS; add budget alerts.
acceptance: Unit costs and monthly estimate are documented with assumptions
Budget alerts exist at 50/80/100 percent
Storage/AI/TURN abuse controls map to cost lines
Plan choice (Pro vs Team) is justified by Realtime limits

stories.title: Abuse cost controls and anomaly detection
stories.description: Prevent storage/AI/relay cost abuse with quotas, anomaly detection and blocking.
acceptance: Anomalies in uploads, AI calls and relay traffic alert and can auto-throttle
New accounts have conservative limits
Support can block abusive couples with audit
Cost per couple is tracked monthly

stories.title: Zero-downtime migration playbook
stories.description: Adopt expand/contract migrations and test them against prod-like data.
acceptance: Playbook covers expand, backfill, dual-write and contract
Migrations are tested on a prod-sized copy
Rollback is possible at each step
CI rejects destructive migrations on main

stories.title: Disaster recovery plan
stories.description: Document region/provider outage response with RTO/RPO and a tested failover path.
acceptance: Failure scenarios and responses are documented
RTO/RPO are approved
A failover tabletop is completed
Communication templates and owners are defined

stories.title: Unit coverage for rewritten domain modules
stories.description: Raise unit coverage on auth context, tenancy, chat, room sync, quotas and visibility.
acceptance: >=80% line/branch coverage on rewritten domain modules
Coverage gate runs in CI with justified exclusions
No snapshot-only tests for critical logic
Tests are deterministic

stories.title: Playwright e2e for critical journeys
stories.description: Cover signup, invite, chat, gallery, export and deletion on web.
acceptance: e2e runs in CI against a seeded staging-like environment
Flows use real auth and RLS
Failures capture trace/screenshots/video
Calls are stubbed via a deterministic test transport

stories.title: Maestro mobile e2e
stories.description: Cover native auth, chat, gallery and deletion flows in CI/preview devices.
acceptance: Flows run on iOS and Android simulators
Auth uses test accounts with cleanup
Failures are easy to diagnose
Runs within CI budget

stories.title: Mandatory tenancy and security regression gate
stories.description: Make cross-couple and RLS tests a required check for every change touching schema, policies, routes or storage.
acceptance: Gate runs on every PR and cannot be skipped by labels
New tables fail CI until policies/tests exist
Storage and realtime auth tests are included
Results are linked in the PR template

stories.title: Flaky-test quarantine and CI time budget
stories.description: Track flakes, quarantine with owners and keep CI reliable and fast.
acceptance: Flake detection reports over the last N runs
Quarantined tests have owner and expiry
Median CI under 10 minutes
No silent retries for product-code tests

stories.title: API contract tests web/native
stories.description: Version the API client contract and test web/native compatibility.
acceptance: API schemas are versioned and generated types are committed
Breaking changes fail contract tests
Mobile compatibility window is documented
Contract tests run in CI

stories.title: Web performance budgets
stories.description: Add Lighthouse CI budgets for LCP/INP/CLS on critical pages.
acceptance: Budgets cover first-route JS ≤250 KB gzipped, LCP/INP/CLS and Lighthouse performance on critical pages
Regressions block merge or require an approved waiver
Budgets are based on measured mobile devices
Report is visible to the team

stories.title: Privacy policy, terms and safety guidelines
stories.description: Publish legally reviewed privacy policy, terms, safety guidelines and data-processing details at stable URLs.
acceptance: Policy covers data categories, storage/AI/TURN processors, retention and rights
Terms cover UGC, acceptable use, suspension and age 18+
Safety guidelines explain reporting/blocking
Pages are linked from app, store listings and emails

stories.title: Apple privacy labels and tracking declaration
stories.description: Complete App Store privacy details and document no-tracking/ATT decision.
acceptance: Data types collected/linked are accurate for Supabase, Sentry, push and AI
No tracking declaration matches SDKs
ATT decision is documented
Labels match the privacy policy

stories.title: Google Play Data Safety and content rating
stories.description: Complete the Data Safety form and content rating accurately.
acceptance: Data collected/shared and security practices match reality
Deletion request path is declared
Content rating answers are consistent with UGC controls
Form evidence is stored

stories.title: Account deletion evidence for stores
stories.description: Prove in-app deletion on web and native and prepare review notes per Apple 5.1.1(v).
acceptance: Deletion is discoverable in-app without contacting support
Review notes include path and test account
Deletion removes data per policy
Recorded evidence is stored

stories.title: UGC compliance evidence pack (Apple 1.2)
stories.description: Assemble filtering, reporting, blocking, contact and response-time evidence.
acceptance: Evidence shows mechanisms and SLAs for each 1.2 requirement
Moderation queue is operational
Contact info is public
Pack is included in review notes

stories.title: Google Play closed testing track
stories.description: If on a personal Play account, run the required closed test with 12 testers for 14 days; otherwise document organisation exemption.
acceptance: Testing track has >=12 opted-in testers for 14 continuous days (if required)
Feedback is triaged and fixes tracked
Exemption evidence exists for organisation accounts
Dates recorded

stories.title: Production native builds and device verification
stories.description: Build signed iOS/Android releases targeting API 36 with 16 KB pages and test on physical devices.
acceptance: AAB targets API 36; 16 KB check passes
iOS archive passes App Store validation
Critical flows pass on minimum/target OS devices
Build versions and commits are recorded

stories.title: Store listings and review notes
stories.description: Prepare screenshots, copy, privacy links and review notes including YouTube/no-screen-share claims.
acceptance: Listings describe the product accurately and avoid DRM claims
Screenshots show real UI with representative demo couple
Review notes explain UGC controls, calls and YouTube embed
All links resolve

stories.title: Kenya ODPC and cross-border compliance
stories.description: Confirm registration duties, cross-border transfer basis, DPIA and breach timelines with counsel.
acceptance: Registration/exemption position documented
Cross-border transfer clauses and processor list are in the policy
DPIA completed for sensitive couple data
Breach notification timeline and owner are set

stories.title: Launch checklist and go/no-go
stories.description: Run a final gated checklist with rollback, monitoring window and support staffing.
acceptance: All P0 stories closed and evidence linked
Rollback tested for web and staged app releases
Support/on-call coverage confirmed for launch week
Go/no-go signed by a human

stories.title: Extract design tokens from the existing look
stories.description: Move the colours, type, spacing, radii and motion values used by the current universe design into packages/ui-tokens so web and native can share them without changing the visual identity.
acceptance: Tokens package builds and is consumed by the web app
A visual check of home/chat shows no unintended change
Reduced-motion tokens exist and are used by the main animations
Remaining hardcoded duplicates are documented with a removal plan

stories.title: Server-evaluated feature flags
stories.description: Add a small feature-flag layer for risky features (paywall, licensed catalogue, screen share, new sync transport) with safe defaults and per-couple allowlists.
acceptance: Flags are evaluated server-side and cannot be forced by a client
Defaults keep unfinished/legal-gated features off
An allowlist can enable a flag for one staging couple
Flag changes are audited and covered by tests

stories.title: Optional password and MFA
stories.description: Let users add a password (with breached-password checking) and TOTP/passkey MFA, with recovery codes and store-compliant UX.
acceptance: Password sign-in works alongside OTP and rejects breached passwords
TOTP enrolment, verification and recovery codes work
MFA can be removed only after re-authentication
Recovery paths are documented and tested

stories.title: Flag-gated paywall UI
stories.description: Add entitlement-driven paywall screens behind a flag, without enabling billing or hardcoding prices until a human decides the model.
acceptance: Paywall renders plan benefits from entitlements, not hardcoded prices
Flag off means no paywall anywhere
Platform billing rules are researched and recorded in an ADR before enabling
Purchase paths are stubbed and clearly disabled in v1

stories.title: Shared calendar with two time zones
stories.description: Give each couple a shared calendar showing events in both partners' local times, with reminders that respect notification preferences.
acceptance: Events are couple-scoped and show both local times
Create/edit/delete works on web and native
Reminders honour quiet hours and per-partner time zones
DST and travel changes do not shift events unexpectedly

stories.title: Shared lists and bucket list with progress
stories.description: Add shared lists (including a bucket list) with check-off, ordering and progress that syncs between partners.
acceptance: Lists and items are couple-scoped with realtime updates
Check-off progress is consistent after reconnect
Bucket-list completions can link to a memory or gallery item
Offline edits queue and reconcile without duplicates

stories.title: Notes and time-capsule letters
stories.description: Let partners write shared notes and time-capsule letters that stay sealed until a chosen date.
acceptance: Notes are couple-private and editable per rules
Letters are sealed server-side until the open date and cannot be read early via API
Notification is sent when a letter opens
Content is included in export and purged on deletion

stories.title: Check-ins and thinking-of-you nudges
stories.description: Add an optional daily check-in and a rate-limited nudge that sends a gentle notification, with quiet hours respected.
acceptance: Check-in state is per person and optionally shared with the partner
Nudges are rate limited and respect quiet hours and notification settings
No covert tracking or presence disclosure beyond explicit state
Both partners can disable check-ins and nudges

stories.title: Couple quizzes and games
stories.description: Add lightweight asynchronous quizzes/games based on the couple's own answers or curated prompts.
acceptance: A quiz can be started, answered and revealed by both partners
No timed pressure or streak punishment
Questions avoid sensitive topics unless the couple opts in
Results are couple-private and exportable

stories.title: Long-distance mode
stories.description: Show both partners' local times and a countdown to the next visit, with no location access unless explicitly shared.
acceptance: Both local times and day boundaries are correct
Next-visit countdown is editable and time-zone aware
No location permission or background tracking is requested
Mode can be turned off with no residual presence sharing

stories.title: App lock and discreet notification options
stories.description: Add biometric/PIN app lock on native and discreet notification text or neutral app icon options for safety.
acceptance: App lock can be enabled per device and fails closed
Notification previews can be fully hidden per partner/device
Discreet icon option follows platform capabilities and store rules
No covert monitoring or hidden permissions are added

stories.title: Call during media and picture-in-picture
stories.description: Let a couple keep a video call visible in picture-in-picture while a room plays, with correct audio focus.
acceptance: PiP call works over the room on supported platforms
Audio focus rules prevent echo and unexpected ducking
Controls remain reachable and accessible
Unsupported platforms get a clear audio-only fallback

stories.title: Public-domain and CC video library
stories.description: Add a curated video provider for public-domain/CC sources with per-item licence and attribution metadata.
acceptance: Only allowlisted, licence-verified sources are playable
Licence and attribution render with each item
No downloads or DRM circumvention
Provider can be disabled by flag without breaking rooms

stories.title: Shared playlists and now-playing state
stories.description: Persist shared playlists and now-playing status so rooms resume and either partner can see what is queued.
acceptance: Playlists are couple-scoped and reorderable
Now-playing state survives reload and late join
Queue history is available without leaking across couples
Empty/ended states are clear on both platforms

stories.title: Background playback and lock-screen controls for allowed sources
stories.description: Support background audio and lock-screen controls only for sources whose licences/platform rules allow it; YouTube remains foreground-only.
acceptance: Background playback works for uploads/podcasts/CC sources where allowed
YouTube never plays in the background and the UI says so
Lock-screen/Media Session controls work and stay in sync
Audio focus, interruptions and calls are handled

stories.title: Sync-protocol package and deterministic simulator
stories.description: Build packages/sync-protocol with events, server-clock estimation, drift correction and a CI simulator before the UI consumes it.
acceptance: Events use {type, positionMs, serverTimeMs, seq, authorId} with server-assigned ordering
Drift rules: ignore <150 ms, rate-nudge 150-1000 ms, hard seek >1000 ms
Heartbeats at most 1 per 5 s per client; handlers are idempotent
Simulator covers latency, jitter, loss and reorder and asserts p95 drift <500 ms

stories.title: Curated date ideas and activity library
stories.description: Add an offline-capable library of date ideas and activities with categories, saves and plans.
acceptance: Content is licence-clean and attributed where needed
Library is readable offline on native
Saved/planned activities are couple-scoped
No external API is required for core browsing

stories.title: Optional places and map ideas with location off by default
stories.description: Add optional saved places/map ideas; location sharing is off by default, per-person and visibly revocable.
acceptance: No location permission is requested unless the user opts in
Shared location is visible, per-person and instantly revocable
No background or covert location tracking exists
Places are couple-private and exportable

stories.title: Home-screen widgets
stories.description: Add read-only home-screen widgets for days together, next-visit countdown and partner local time where the platform allows.
acceptance: Widgets render correctly on supported iOS/Android versions
Data refreshes within platform budgets without background abuse
Widgets hide content under a discreet mode
Unsupported platforms degrade gracefully

stories.title: Low-bandwidth mode and offline reading
stories.description: Add a low-bandwidth mode with no autoplay, smaller images and deferred sync, plus offline reading of core screens.
acceptance: Mode can be manual or auto-detected on slow networks
No autoplay video; images are resized; sync defers politely
Home, chat history, story and lists are readable offline
Queued sends and uploads resume on reconnect

stories.title: Copyright takedown and counter-notice flow
stories.description: Add a documented copyright/DMCA-style takedown process, form and admin workflow for reported content.
acceptance: Published policy and contact exist (counsel-reviewed)
Report intake captures required fields and evidence
Admin can remove content and notify uploader per policy
Counter-notice and repeat-infringer steps are documented

stories.title: Re-authentication for sensitive actions
stories.description: Require fresh authentication before export, deletion, unlink, email change or secret changes.
acceptance: Sensitive actions require a recent OTP/passkey re-auth
Re-auth cannot be bypassed by stale sessions
Failures are rate limited and audited
UX explains why and offers recovery

stories.title: E2EE private vault ADR
stories.description: Write an ADR for a future end-to-end-encrypted private vault, covering search, backup, multi-device and moderation trade-offs.
acceptance: ADR compares E2EE designs and their costs
No E2EE claims appear in the product until implemented and reviewed
Recommendation and prerequisites are recorded
Security and privacy docs link to the ADR

stories.title: CSP and security headers
stories.description: Add a strict Content-Security-Policy, HSTS, frame-ancestors, referrer and permissions policies, and eliminate wildcard CORS.
acceptance: CSP works with Next.js/YouTube embed and is enforced in production mode
Security headers pass an external scan with no critical issues
CORS origins are explicitly allowlisted
Violations are reported without leaking content

stories.title: Safety resources and discreet help screen
stories.description: Provide a safety resources screen with regional crisis/abuse links and a discreet way to leave the app quickly.
acceptance: Resources are available from settings and the safety page
Screen can be exited discreetly and does not expose browsing history
Content is reviewed by a human before launch
Links resolve and are accessible

stories.title: OWASP MASVS-L1 style security review
stories.description: Run an OWASP MASVS-L1-style checklist across web and native and fix or document every applicable finding.
acceptance: Checklist results are committed with evidence
Critical/high findings are fixed or explicitly accepted by a human
Secrets, storage, transport and platform permissions are covered
Review is repeated before launch

stories.title: Resilience tests for bad networks and clocks
stories.description: Test losing network mid-upload, reconnecting mid-room and clock skew, and fix the resulting UX.
acceptance: Interrupted uploads resume without corruption or duplicates
Room reconnects and resyncs to the correct position
Clock skew does not break countdowns or questions
Results are recorded in VERIFICATION

stories.title: Mobile performance and bundle budgets
stories.description: Measure and enforce cold start <2.5 s on a mid-range Android device and bounded JS/bundle sizes with list virtualisation.
acceptance: Cold start is measured on a mid-range physical device
Web first-route JS is ≤250 KB gzipped
Lists are virtualised and images lazy-load
Budgets are checked before release

stories.title: DPIA for sensitive couple data
stories.description: Complete a data protection impact assessment covering intimate content, cross-border transfers, AI, moderation and deletion.
acceptance: DPIA follows the Kenyan/other applicable framework with counsel
Risks and mitigations are recorded and linked to stories
Transfer safeguards and processor DPAs are attached
A human signs off before launch

stories.title: Rebrand to Let'sVibe with compatibility
stories.description: Apply the approved brand rename from Our Universe to Let'sVibe (technical slug letsvibe) across metadata, visible UI, documentation, package identity and scripts while preserving session/encryption compatibility and historical evidence.
acceptance: Brand source of truth exists and metadata/manifest/UI use it
No user-facing Our Universe remains outside historical notes and the unchanged GitHub remote
Technical identifiers use letsvibe; cookies/crypto keys stay stable for compatibility and are documented
Gates pass and ADR-002 records naming rules, legal/handle risks and rollout
stories.notes: Rebranded visible UI, metadata, package identity, scripts and docs to Let'sVibe/letsvibe. Compatibility identifiers frozen per ADR-002: ou_session, ou_verses, ou_vows, ou:* storage/events, ou-q:, and our-universe/* crypto labels. GitHub remote unchanged. Gates: next typegen, typecheck, lint, 5 files/44 tests, build (33 pages) all pass.
